pricingTiers.name: Blaze
pricingTiers.notes: Pay as you go, not a fixed subscription; includes applicable free quotas. Example App Hosting cached outgoing bandwidth above 10 GiB/month costs $0.15/GiB; uncached $0.20/GiB. Other Cloud services billed separately; no synthetic annual total.
No separate enterprise Firebase subscription verified on pricing page; Google Cloud service editions and support do not establish a suite price.
